early_termination.value: No discretionary early termination right for Tenant. Tenant may terminate only on casualty/condemnation events: (i) if Premises substantially destroyed and Tenant finds rebuilding uneconomic (notice within 60 days of casualty, Section 14.4); (ii) if Landlord fails to substantially repair within 9 months of casualty notice (Tenant notice within 30 days after that period, Section 14.5); (iii) condemnation that adversely impedes access or Tenant's ability to operate (Sections 15.2/15.3). No termination fee is stated.
early_termination.quote: within nine (9) months of the date that Tenant notifies Landlord of the casualty, Tenant shall have the option to terminate the Lease.
early_termination.note: No fee or voluntary break option found; Section 14.4 wording is garbled ('notice to Tenant') but evidences a Tenant election.

security_deposit.note: Cash/LC form not specified; payable on Tenant's execution of the Lease (Article 19).
